## Findings and disclosure for Seth

D4 moves diagnostic persistence outside engine/catalog authority, with immutable capture and fresh guarded settlement. Functional evidence remains the1814-test builder run/four skips, old R1/R2/A1 controls and15 killed D4 mutants; final harness controls27 pass. Every sampled final comparison passed, but historical~1.1s stalls and two later admit_saved misses remain unexplained. The sentinel shares GIL/volume, temporal attribution is not causal proof, and no qualifying event was used to excuse this final run. Max-based checks were run with the declared sentinel and every sample retained. No guarantee about all future OS latency follows from finite samples.

The earlier30+30 data has a129-request vs prepared-peer130-request comparison limitation. Its improved observations still do not establish why the previous samples were slower. No product code, limit or retained-state budget was changed to obtain this final result.
